description: This file contains FastAPI route handlers for processing file uploads, supporting both raw bytes files and UploadFile objects, with endpoints '/files/' and '/uploadfile/'.

methods.name: create_file(file: Annotated[Union[bytes, None], File()] = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload a file as raw bytes or None, returning the size of the file or a message if no file was sent.

methods.name: create_upload_file(file: Union[UploadFile, None] = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload a file as an UploadFile object or None, returning the filename or a message if no file was sent.

ctags.name: create_file
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_file(file: Annotated[Union[bytes, None], File()] = None):$/
